## NativeBodyOptions.absentValueMarkers property

Hand the codec the value of each property whose evidence makes the app's "no such object" failure its empty value marked as such, so the codec takes that failure, raised while it reads the value's identity, as `null` (<!-- -->).

Only a body whose result the codec encodes by a typed plan wants this. Under a passthrough plan the codec returns the result unchanged, so a marker would reach the caller as it is. A failed read of such a property is `null` either way. Defaults to `true`<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
readonly absentValueMarkers?: boolean;
```
